# Timely

Timely is an automatic time-tracking platform capturing activity across applications, calendars, and devices, creating detailed timesheets for billing or productivity insights

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/timely/.

## Actions

- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook for the specified account.
- **Retrieve an account** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific account by its id.
